snp3.6:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
snp3.6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sabhiyassa paribbājakassa purāṇasālohitāya devatāya pañhā uddiṭṭhā honti,
snp3.6:1.4: yo te sabhiya samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ime pañhe puṭṭho vyākaroti, tassa santike brahmacariyaṃ careyyāsīti.
snp3.6:2.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbajāko tassā devatāya santike te pañhe uggahetvā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyathidaṃ:
snp3.6:2.2: pūraṇo kassapo makkhali gosālo ajito kesakambalo pakudho kaccāyano sañjayo bellaṭṭhi putto nigaṇṭhonātaputto.
snp3.6:2.4: te sabhiyena paribbājakena pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti.
snp3.6:3.2: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyathīdaṃ.
snp3.6:3.4: te mayā pañhe puṭṭhā na sampāyanti
snp3.6:4.2: ayampi samaṇo gotamo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassi titthakaro sādhusammāto bahujanassa,
snp3.6:4.3: yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ime pañhe puccheyyanti.
snp3.6:5.2: yepi kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā jiṇṇā vuddhā mahallakā addhagatā vayo anuppattā therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, yeyyathidaṃ:
snp3.6:5.4: tepi mayā pañhe puṭṭho na sampāyanti.
snp3.6:5.5: asampāyantā kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaronti, api ca maññevettha paṭipucchanti,
snp3.6:5.6: kaṃ pana me samaṇo gotamo ime pañhe puṭṭho vyākarissati,
snp3.6:5.7: samaṇo hi gotamo daharo ceva va jātiyā navo ca pabbajāyāti:
snp3.6:6.3: daharopi cesa samaṇo gotamo mahiddhiko hoti mahānubhāvo, yannūnāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ime pañhe puccheyyanti.
snp3.6:7.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako yena rājagahaṃ tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
snp3.6:7.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena rājagahaṃ veḷuvanaṃ kalandakanivāpo, yena bhagavā tenupaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
snp3.6:7.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
snp3.6:7.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
snp3.6:11.2: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
snp3.6:11.3: yaṃ vatāhaṃ aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammamattampi nālatthaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ samaṇena gotamena okāsakammaṃ katanti
snp3.6:11.4: attamano pamodito udaggo pītisomanassajāto bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ pucchi: kiṃ
snp3.6:14.4: ussadā yassa na santi sorato so.
snp3.6:17.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā attamano pamodito udaggo pītisomanassajāto bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ pucchi: kiṃ
snp3.6:23.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako …pe… bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
snp3.6:29.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako …pe… bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
snp3.6:35.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako …pe… bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
snp3.6:39.4: paṭighā yassa na santi caraṇavā so.
snp3.6:41.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā attamano pamudito udaggo pītisomanassajāto uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi:
snp3.6:42.1: yāni ca tīṇi yāni ca saṭṭhi
snp3.6:52.1: atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
snp3.6:52.4: labheyyāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti,
snp3.6:53.1: yo kho sabhiya, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ so cattāro māse parivasati, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhu pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhu
snp3.6:54.1: sace bhante, aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhupabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya, ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi, catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhu pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
snp3.6:54.2: alattha kho sabhiyo paribbājako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ …pe…
snp3.6:54.3: aññataro ca kho panāyasmā sabhiyo arahataṃ ahosīti.
